findings.claim: Backup code comparison uses indexOf, which is case-sensitive, and only '-' is stripped from the input. Valid codes typed in a different case or with whitespace are rejected, for example uppercase from iOS auto-capitalize. The same comparison appears in disable.ts and BackupCode.tsx.

The `user.twoFactorEnabled &&` check (line 48) and the `else if (user.twoFactorEnabled)` check (line 69) are always true after the early return at line 36. The CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY check is copied into both branches.
The e2e assertion `expect(locator.isChecked()).toBeTruthy()` checks a Promise object, which is always truthy, rather than the resolved boolean. It is left unfixed despite an added FIXME.

`navigator.clipboard.writeText()` is not awaited or error-handled, so the success toast shows even when the write fails. Where navigator.clipboard is undefined (plain-HTTP non-localhost), the click throws.
When totpEmail is present, the login page renders ExternalTotpFooter, so SAML/Google users never see the backup-code entry point.
